_note: Modalities that are NOT modelled (or only stubbed), with the reason. Nothing in this file feeds the simulator.

diamond_nv.label: Diamond colour-centre spins (NV / SiV)
diamond_nv.reason: Different class of devices: room-temperature sensing-grade systems and small-qubit-count processors (the overview lists Quantum Brilliance). No published fault-tolerant roadmap with resource numbers was verified in this audit, so any overhead or power figure would be invented.
diamond_nv.what_it_would_need: photon-mediated entanglement rates, spin-photon interface fidelity, per-node power (lasers, microwave, optionally cryostat), network architecture

topological.label: Topological (Majorana) qubits
topological.reason: Microsoft Majorana 1 is announced as a platform of eight topological qubits whose topological nature is contested; no demonstrated logical qubit, no error-rate or cycle-time data suitable for a resource model. A projected overhead would be speculation.
topological.source: Microsoft announcement and press coverage, February 2025 (via search in this audit); the contested-evidence remark is general knowledge and was not re-verified.

gate_model_dual_rail.label: Dual-rail superconducting qubits (Quantum Circuits / D-Wave)
gate_model_dual_rail.status: covered by cat_superconducting as a proxy only
gate_model_dual_rail.reason: Erasure-biased dual-rail qubits have a different error structure from bias-preserving cat qubits; the cat model's repetition code does not apply. D-Wave announced (Jan 2026) an agreement to acquire Quantum Circuits for about USD 550 million; closing was not verified.
